heading: Ferrari F12 Berlinetta — carbon, gloss and protection
summary: This 2015 F12 Berlinetta combines carbon upgrades, gloss-black wrap details and Verleno high-gloss PPF in one documented build.
detail: The recorded work brings together exterior carbon aero, interior trim and carbon door-seal wrap. Gloss-black wrapping and paint protection film are separate parts of the finish, alongside the lighting and exhaust work listed below.

heading: Chrysler 300 Hellcat — satin pearl white
summary: Satin pearl white wrapping, gloss-black racing stripes and yellow details complete this custom Chrysler 300 Hellcat build.
detail: Full bodywork, a custom ZR1 glass hood and forged-carbon parts form the foundation of the recorded project. The wrap, stripes, pinstriping and Hellcat decal bring its individual elements together.

heading: Mercedes-Benz E55 AMG — charcoal grey transformation
summary: A KKVinyl charcoal-grey wrap and gloss-black roof define this 2004 E55 AMG, with ceramic coating recorded as part of the build.
detail: The project pairs a colour change and chrome delete with custom body and lighting work. The recorded coating is described as a five-year product; that description is not a blanket warranty for another vehicle or installation.

heading: Infiniti Q50S — chameleon colour shift
summary: This 2017 Q50S combines removal of its previous wrap, a chameleon colour-shift wrap, chrome delete and ceramic coating.
detail: The recorded removal distinguishes this project from a first-time wrap. For a similar transformation, existing film and the condition of the paint beneath it need to be assessed before confirming preparation and scope.

heading: Audi TT — LazerFlip lavender
summary: LazerFlip lavender wrapping, chrome delete and Halo ceramic coating feature on this 2012 right-hand-drive Audi TT.
detail: The recorded services combine a specialty colour finish with contrasting trim and a coating. For your own vehicle, compare physical film samples and confirm coating compatibility and care requirements during consultation.

heading: Subaru WRX — matte grey and carbon accents
summary: This 2023 WRX features matte AMG-grey wrapping, carbon-effect hood and roof wrapping, and Halo ceramic coating.
detail: Contrasting finishes give the hood and roof a different appearance from the body. The original service record also lists taillight and window-visor replacement; carbon-effect wrap describes a finish, not a replacement carbon-fibre panel.
